title: Two different codegen pipelines coexist in v0alpha1 package
answers: Why does regenerating types with the app-sdk generator not pick up Job changes?
Which types are CUE-authored vs hand-written Go in provisioning?
How do I regenerate Job/HistoricJob deepcopy/openapi code?
body: Repository and Connection are CUE-authored (kinds/*.cue -> app-sdk `generate`), but Job, HistoricJob, RepositoryViewList, and health/condition types are plain Go with kubebuilder markers (+k8s:deepcopy-gen, +genclient) regenerated via `./hack/update-codegen.sh provisioning` from the repo root (comment at apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/jobs.go says this explicitly). kinds/manifest.cue only lists `repository` and `connection` as manifest kinds — Job is not part of the CUE manifest at all. Forgetting the right regeneration step leaves zz_generated.deepcopy.go/zz_generated.openapi.go stale, which typically fails CI rather than compilation.
applies: Applies within apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/ and apps/provisioning/kinds/. Does not apply to other apps/* modules unless they show the same split.
